etymology: a primitive root [identical with 06972 through the idea of severing oneself from (compare 06962)]
avSummary: abhor 3, weary 2, loath 1, distressed 1, vex 1, grieved 1
definition:
1) to be grieved, loathe, abhor, feel a loathing or abhorrence or sickening
    dread
    1a) (Qal)
        1a1) to feel a loathing at, abhor
        1a2) to feel a sickening dread
    1b) (Hiphil)
        1b1) to cause sickening dread
        1b2) to cause loathing
